execution_policy: One primary review task and at most one bivariate task, serially under existing locks. Remaining budget is reserve, not permission for automatic expansion.

priorities.title: Reconcile cosine proof corrections and census evidence
priorities.reason: Focused requested review found proof-document inconsistencies while finite tests and kernel bounds passed.
priorities.next_action: Reconcile the small sign-bookkeeping candidate and any new completeness evidence; do not reapply broad original patch or repeat unchanged tests. Tangent proof changes inventoried/deferred without a readiness claim.
priorities.deliverable: Reviewed proof-only patch, source-bound certificates, exact scoped coverage and honest completeness checkpoint.
priorities.acceptance: No whole-function proof or unreachability claim from corpus tests; keep supplied-data verification separate from exhaustive regeneration.
priorities.stop: Checkpoint on changed source or missing premise; do not repeat unchanged campaigns.
priorities.dependency: Pinned cosine source/proof and subsequent maintainer feedback; no broad coverage or exp campaign.
priorities.change: Most proof corrections adopted; extension/completeness commentary retained only as comments. New swap-bit typo has a focused proof candidate and exact algebra check; all13 prior tested input blobs match, no rerun.

priorities.title: Resolve asin cast and integer-range portability
priorities.reason: The passing Clang corpus does not establish signed-subtraction safety or equivalence on LP64 and LLP64.
priorities.next_action: Only pursue a named remaining phi/ph range premise when useful and aligned; do not reapply the adopted cleanup or rerun unchanged corpus checks.
priorities.deliverable: Tested optional unsigned predicate and explicit range/ABI note; next a coarse all-input range lemma under stated floating-point assumptions.
priorities.acceptance: Tests alone do not prove absence of UB. Explicitly distinguish source undefined behavior, compiler miscompilation and unsupported ABI execution.
priorities.stop: Checkpoint on an unqualified ABI, unresolved range premise, source change or cap; do not label unsupported execution a failure.
priorities.dependency: Pinned asin source; qualified toolchains and a small reproducible test harness.
priorities.change: Unsigned-gap candidate adopted upstream at e168ea1a; prior tests retained. Whole-function phi/ph range premise and unsupported ABI execution remain open.

priorities.title: Build independently checkable bivariate regression evidence, hypot first
priorities.reason: The unary suite does not cover the much larger two-input space; small exact certificates can separate generating difficult cases from verifying them.
priorities.next_action: Construct one bounded near-midpoint family, independently verify exact certificates and compare numeric pair membership against the full pinned hypot corpus. No full Cartesian scan; archive import remains blocked.
priorities.deliverable: A standalone exact checker, explicit certificate format and separately qualified four-mode runner; later a hashed archive-import/reproduction receipt.
priorities.acceptance: Exact input decoding, positive/negative controls and bounds; values, flags and errno separate. Table verification does not regenerate a completeness census. No new bug or novelty claim from a hard-but-correct case.
priorities.stop: Stop on a failed control or cap. Recheck archive availability at the next checkpoint, report the blocker once and continue independent infrastructure work; do not silently drop the requested import.
priorities.dependency: Independent verifier and Linux adapter qualified for listed GCC/Clang profiles only. Prior archives are still unavailable; their results remain unverified here.
priorities.change: Rigorous restricted-domain count enclosure and bounded checking-throughput observation show literal pair enumeration infeasible. Earlier certificate/adapter qualification retained.
